calendar_source: Odisha Govt Gazette & Kohinoor / Radharamana Panji

festivals.name: Makar Sankranti
festivals.significance: Celebration of Uttarayana; preparation of Makara Chaula and rituals at Dhabaleswar.

festivals.name: Basanta Panchami / Veer Surendra Sai Jayanti
festivals.odia_name: ବସନ୍ତ ପଞ୍ଚମୀ / ବୀର ସୁରେନ୍ଦ୍ର ସାଏ ଜୟନ୍ତୀ
festivals.significance: Saraswati Puja, birth anniversary of Veer Surendra Sai, and ritual collection of wood for Ratha Yatra chariots.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri (Jagara)
festivals.significance: All-night fast and vigil culminating with the raising of the Mahadipa atop Lingaraj Temple.

festivals.name: Dola Purnima
festivals.significance: Swinging festival of Dola Govinda and Radha, reading of the new Odia Panji.

festivals.name: Holi (Dola Melana)
festivals.significance: Regional colors festival and village gathering of swing idols.

festivals.name: Utkal Divas (Odisha Day)
festivals.significance: Odisha state foundation day commemorating its linguistic formation in 1936.

festivals.name: Maha Bishuba Sankranti / Pana Sankranti
festivals.significance: Solar New Year, hanging of the Basudhara pot, and drinking of Bela Pana.

festivals.name: Akshaya Tritiya / Chandan Yatra Begins
festivals.significance: Akhi Muthi Anukula (ceremonial seed-sowing), Ratha construction start, and Narendra Tank boat festival.

festivals.name: Savitri Amavasya
festivals.significance: Strict marital fast observed by Odia women praying for their husbands' longevity.

festivals.name: Sitalsasthi Yatra
festivals.significance: Divine marriage of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, celebrated predominantly in Sambalpur.

festivals.name: Pahili Raja
festivals.significance: Opening day of the three-day festival celebrating earth's fertility, swing play, and Pitha.

festivals.name: Raja Sankranti
festivals.significance: Peak day of Raja Parba; agriculture completely pauses to let mother earth rest.

festivals.name: Devasnan Purnima (Snana Yatra)
festivals.significance: Ceremonial 108-pot bath of the Trinity on Snana Mandap; initiation of 15-day Anasara.

festivals.name: Puri Ratha Yatra (Sri Gundicha)
festivals.significance: World-famous Chariot Festival procession from Srimandir to Gundicha Temple.

festivals.name: Bahuda Yatra
festivals.significance: Return chariot journey of the deities back to the Singhadwara.

festivals.name: Suna Besha (Bada Tadhau Besha)
festivals.significance: Golden attire darshan of the Holy Trinity atop their chariots in Puri.

festivals.name: Gamha Purnima / Jhulan Purnima
festivals.significance: Balabhadra Janma, livestock worship, traditional gamha-jumping, and culmination of swing rituals.

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.significance: Worship of the Lord of Wisdom across academic institutions and clubs.

festivals.name: Nuakhai
festivals.significance: Western Odisha's premier harvest festival; Nabanna offering to Maa Samaleswari.

festivals.name: Gaja Shasthi
festivals.significance: Traditional Shasthi observance listed in Kohinoor Odia Calendar.

festivals.name: Gandhi Jayanti / Lal Bahadur Shastri Jayanti
festivals.odia_name: ଗାନ୍ଧୀ ଜୟନ୍ତୀ / ଲାଲ ବାହାଦୁର ଶାସ୍ତ୍ରୀ ଜୟନ୍ତୀ
festivals.significance: Birth anniversaries of Mahatma Gandhi and former Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri.

festivals.name: Mula Ashtami / Dwiti Bahana Osha / Sri Durga Devi Uthapana
festivals.significance: Awakening of Goddess Durga, Sahasra Kumbhabhisheka, beginning of 16-day Shodasha Dinatmaka Puja, and Dutibahana Osha (Jitiya).

festivals.name: Indira Ekadashi
festivals.significance: Pitru Paksha Ekadashi fasting and Harinam Sankirtan observed for the liberation of ancestors.

festivals.name: Shiva Chaturdashi & Beda Parikrama
festivals.significance: Monthly Masa Shivaratri fasting and temple circumambulation.

festivals.name: Mahalaya
festivals.significance: Tila Tarpan offerings to ancestors and formal invocation of Maa Durga.

festivals.name: Navaratri Arambha / Maa Biraja Devi Rathayatra
festivals.odia_name: നବରାତ୍ର ଆରମ୍ଭ / ମା ବିରଜା ଦେବୀ ରଥଯାତ୍ରା
festivals.significance: Beginning of 9-day Sharadiya Navaratri Durga Puja, Maa Biraja Devi chariot festival in Jajpur, and Daga Madhaba Bahara Bije.

festivals.name: Chandra Darshan Puja
festivals.significance: Auspicious sighting and worship of the new crescent moon after Amavasya.

festivals.name: Nata Panchami / Guru Panchami Brata
festivals.significance: Maa Biraja Devi Panchami Homa and traditional Guru Panchami Brata.

festivals.name: Tapah Shasthi / Bilwadhiwasa (Durga Shasthi)
festivals.significance: Mrunmayee Devi Bilwadhiwasa invocation ritual under the Bel tree on the eve of Maha Saptami.

festivals.name: Durga Puja (Maha Saptami)
festivals.significance: Beginning of full-scale public pandal worship of Goddess Durga in Cuttack and Bhubaneswar.

festivals.name: Maha Ashtami Puja (Durga Puja)
festivals.significance: Culminating Sandhi Puja of Goddess Durga and start of Sharana period (Sharana Arambha).

festivals.name: Maha Navami Puja (Durga Puja)
festivals.significance: Maha Navami worship and Chandi Homa across Shakti Peethas and public pandals.

festivals.name: Dussehra / Vijaya Dashami
festivals.significance: Culmination of Sharadiya Durga Puja, Aparajita Puja, Astra Puja, and Ravan Podi.

festivals.name: Dashahara in Srimandir / Durga Puja Bisarjan & Somanatha Brata
festivals.odia_name: ଶ୍ରୀମନ୍ଦିରରେ ଦଶହରା / ଭସାଣି ଓ ସୋମନାଥ ବ୍ରତ
festivals.significance: Rajarajeswara (Suna) Besha in Srimandir, conclusion of Somanatha Brata, and ceremonial idol immersion (Bhasani).

festivals.name: Papankusha Ekadashi
festivals.significance: Ashwina Shukla Ekadashi fasting and Harinam Sankirtan.

festivals.name: Sharana Shesha
festivals.significance: Conclusion of the monthly Panchaka / Sharana Nakshatra period.

festivals.name: Shiva Chaturdashi Fasting & Beda Parikrama
festivals.odia_name: ଶିବ ଚତୁର୍ଦ୍ଦଶୀ ଉପବାସ ଓ ବେଢ଼ା ପରିକ୍ରମା
festivals.significance: Chaturdashi fasting, temple circumambulation, and 4th Saturday Bank Holiday.

festivals.name: Kumar Purnima / Gajalaxmi Puja Begins
festivals.significance: Moon worship (Chandra Puja) by unmarried youth; start of 11-day Dhenkanal Lakshmi Puja.

festivals.name: Kartika Brata Arambha / Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti
festivals.significance: Purnima observance, commencement of the sacred month-long Kartika Habisha Vrata, and Valmiki Jayanti.

festivals.name: Karaka Chaturthi (Karva Chauth)
festivals.significance: Traditional Chaturthi fast for marital longevity and moonrise worship.

festivals.name: Shashthi Mela
festivals.significance: Regional Shashthi Mela observance.

festivals.name: Rama Ekadashi
festivals.significance: Kartika Krishna Ekadashi fasting and Hala Nishedha.

festivals.name: Govatsa Dwadashi
festivals.significance: Worship of cows and calves marking the start of Deepavali festivities.

festivals.name: Diwali / Kali Puja / Bada Badua Daka
festivals.significance: Festival of lights; burning Kaunriya sticks in Puri to invite and guide ancestor spirits.

festivals.name: Govardhan Puja (Holiday Observance)
festivals.significance: Holiday observance for Govardhan Puja following Deepavali.

festivals.name: Govardhan Puja / Annakut & Chandra Darshan
festivals.odia_name: ଗୋବର୍ଦ୍ଧନ ପୂଜା / অନ୍ନକୂଟ ଓ ଚନ୍ଦ୍ର ଦର୍ଶନ
festivals.significance: Annakut offering to Lord Krishna and auspicious Chandra Darshan Puja.

festivals.name: Yama Dwitiya / Bhai Dooj
festivals.significance: Ritual celebrating the bond between brothers and sisters and worship of Yamuna and Yama.

festivals.name: Naga Chaturthi
festivals.significance: Worship of Nagas (serpent deities) for family protection and wellbeing.

festivals.name: Children's Day (Nehru Jayanti) & Sharana Arambha
festivals.significance: Birth anniversary of Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, 2nd Saturday Bank Holiday, and start of Sharana period.

festivals.name: Chhath Puja (Surya Shashthi)
festivals.significance: Worship of Surya Deva and Chhathi Maiya at riverbanks at sunset and sunrise.

festivals.name: Vrischika Sankranti / Kartikeya Puja
festivals.significance: Sun enters Vrischika Rashi (Margashira solar month begins), Kartikeya Puja, and Sholasa Asana Amrita Manohi Bhoga.

festivals.name: Gopashtami
festivals.significance: Go-Puja (worship of cows and Goshalas) commemorating Lord Krishna becoming a cowherd.

festivals.name: Anla Navami
festivals.significance: Worship of the Amla tree and sacred 'Radha Pada Darshan' at Sakshigopal Temple.

festivals.name: Sharana Shesha
festivals.significance: End of the monthly Sharana period.

festivals.name: Sharad Rasa Adhiwasa / Radha-Damodara Besha Ends
festivals.odia_name: ଶରଦ ରାସ ଅଧିବାସ / ରାଧା ଦାମୋଦର ବେଶ ସମାପ୍ତ
festivals.significance: Conclusion of the month-long Radha-Damodara Besha at Srimandir before Panchuka begins.

festivals.name: Devotthapana (Bada) Ekadashi / Tulasi Vivah & Bhishma Panchaka
festivals.odia_name: ବଡ଼ ଏକାଦଶୀ / ତୁଳସୀ ବିବାହ ଓ ଭୀଷ୍ମ ପଞ୍ଚକ
festivals.significance: Awakening of Lord Vishnu (Prabodhini Ekadashi), Laxmi-minarayan Besha at Puri, Garuda Dwadashi, and start of 5-day Panchuka Vrata.

festivals.name: Rahas Purnima
festivals.significance: Culmination of Kartika month devotion and Raas Leela performances.

festivals.name: Kartika Purnima / Boita Bandana & Bali Jatra
festivals.significance: Floating of toy paper boats to commemorate Kalinga maritime voyages; launch of the Cuttack Bali Jatra.

festivals.name: Chadakhai
festivals.significance: Traditional feast day marking the end of the month-long vegetarian vow of Kartika.

festivals.name: Manabasa Gurubar (First Thursday of Margashira)
festivals.significance: First Thursday of Margashira month dedicated to Goddess Mahalakshmi worship and Jhoti Chita.

festivals.name: Sita Vivaha (Vivaha Panchami)
festivals.significance: Celebration of the divine wedding of Lord Rama and Goddess Sita; 4th Saturday Bank Holiday.

festivals.name: Shreekhetra Parikrama
festivals.significance: Sacred circumambulation of Shreekhetra (Puri Dham) by devotees.

festivals.name: Prathamastami
festivals.significance: Ceremony honoring the eldest child of the family with new attire and turmeric-leaf Enduri Pitha.

festivals.name: Manabasa Gurubar (Margashira Thursday)
festivals.significance: Weekly Thursday worship of Goddess Lakshmi with freshly harvested paddy (Mana) and Pitha offerings.

festivals.name: Utpanna Ekadashi / Deba Deepavali Begins at Srimandir
festivals.odia_name: ଉତ୍ପନ୍ନା ଏକାଦଶୀ / ଶ୍ରୀମନ୍ଦିରରେ ଦେବ ଦୀପାବଳି ଆରମ୍ଭ
festivals.significance: Utpanna Ekadashi fasting, Harinam Sankirtan, and start of the 3-day Deba Deepavali lamp offering by Lord Jagannath to His ancestral forms.

festivals.name: Mahodadhi Amavasya / Deba Deepavali & Gosahasthi Snana
festivals.significance: Sacred sea bath at Puri (Mahodadhi), Deba Deepavali rituals at Srimandir, Chandra Kshaya night vigil, and Hala Nishedha (Dec 7–9).

festivals.name: Chandra Darshan Puja
festivals.significance: Auspicious sighting and worship of the new crescent moon with fasting.

festivals.name: Rambha Tritiya
festivals.significance: Traditional Margashira Shukla Tritiya vrata observance.

festivals.name: Sharana Arambha / 2nd Saturday Bank Holiday
festivals.significance: Start of the monthly Sharana period and 2nd Saturday Bank Holiday.

festivals.name: Kural Panchami
festivals.significance: Traditional festival of the Kumbhara (potter) community worshipping Lord Rudrapala and the potter's wheel.

festivals.name: Odana Shashthi (Prabarana Shashthi)
festivals.significance: Ceremonial dressing of the Holy Trinity in starched winter garments (Ghodagi/Phuta) marking the onset of winter.

festivals.name: Dhanu Sankranti / Pahili Bhoga Begins
festivals.significance: Sun enters Dhanu Rashi (Pausa solar month); Dhanu Muan offering and start of month-long early-morning Pahili Bhoga at Srimandir.

festivals.name: Sharana Shesha
festivals.significance: Conclusion of the monthly Sharana period.

festivals.name: Mokshada Ekadashi / Rabinarayan Brata
festivals.significance: Margashira Shukla Ekadashi fasting and Rabinarayan Brata observance.

festivals.name: Byanjana Dwadashi
festivals.significance: Offering of hundreds of traditional varieties of cooked delicacies (Byanjana) to Lord Krishna, commemorating Yashoda Mata's love.

festivals.name: Ananga Trayodashi / Gita Jayanti & Pashana Chaturdashi
festivals.odia_name: ଅନଙ୍ଗ ତ୍ରୟୋଦଶୀ / ଗୀତା ଜୟନ୍ତୀ ଓ ପାଷାଣ ଚତୁର୍ଦ୍ଦଶୀ
festivals.significance: Commemoration of the Bhagavad Gita discourse, Shiva-Kama worship, and Pashana Chaturdashi Pitha offerings.

festivals.name: Pandu Osha / Chandra Puja & Hazarat Ali's Birthday
festivals.significance: Pandu Purnima eve observance, Chandra Puja fasting, and Hazarat Ali's Birthday.

festivals.name: Margashira Purnima (Pandu Purnima) & Christmas Eve
festivals.significance: Culmination of the auspicious month of Margashira and Christmas Eve.

festivals.name: Christmas Day (Bada Dina)
festivals.significance: Celebration of the birth of Jesus Christ; public and bank holiday across Odisha.

festivals.name: Danda Pahara & Bata Osha
festivals.significance: Traditional Pausa Krishna Pratipada / Dwitiya pathway worship (Bata Osha) and 4th Saturday Bank Holiday.

festivals.name: Pathani Samanta Jayanti / English Year-End
festivals.significance: Birth anniversary of Mahamahopadhyaya Chandra Sekhar Singha Harichandan Mahapatra (Pathani Samanta), Odisha's legendary astronomer.
